content.short: Launchifi helps launch blockchain-based projects quickly using easy-to-use dashboards.
content.description: Web3 onboarding remains challenging for newcomers due to a steep learning curve, the risk of missteps, and the threat of bad actors targeting new builders. Launchifi lets people with limited technical knowledge deploy popular smart contract types, reducing barriers to entry. The platform aims to deliver consumer blockchain infrastructure as SaaS and open-source software, enabling anyone to launch their blockchain project or company in little to no time through easy, intuitive dashboards.
content.meta: Launchifi enables anyone with little to no technical knowledge to launch smart contracts. Discover Launchifi and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
